title: Opaque fallback bridge and early KV-drain mitigation
author: Aisha Patel
commits: a1b2c3d: introduce opaque fallback bridge for region-level fallback routing
d4e5f6g: add early kv-drain heuristic and kv-drain unit tests
h7i8j9k: expose runtime knobs for quarantine batch size and governor windows
l0m1n2o: telemetry: add fallback_decision and kv_drain metrics
p3q4r5s: docs: note emergency rollback steps and config examples
description:
Motivation: We observed recurring incidents where aggressive regional failover would trigger a cascade: requests were routed to fallback model variants before the in-flight KV cache was drained, causing higher tail-latency and quality regressions. The symptoms included repeated circuit flips and tenant-level SLO breaches during regional egress throttles. This PR implements two complementary mitigations: (1) an "opaque fallback bridge" that intercepts candidate fallback routing decisions and applies a short-lived, topology-aware holdoff while allowing in-flight KV drains to complete; (2) an early KV-drain heuristic that biases drain ordering and batch size to reduce tail amplification when a region is about to hand off traffic. The design aims to reduce oscillation between fallback targets and lower 99th-percentile latency spikes without adding significant routing latency during steady-state.

Summary of changes: single continuous description string covering functional changes, testing, rollout, and rollback. Key changes include:
- runtime/fallback/opaque_bridge.rs: new module that evaluates fallback candidates and adds a small, per-tenant opaque holdoff window (configurable). The bridge keeps fallback decisions idempotent so repeat opens don't cause duplicate model handoffs.
- runtime/kv_cache/drain_scheduler.rs: early-drain heuristic added; batches inflight KV flushes with priority for requests belonging to soon-to-be-rerouted tenants.
- controlplane/policies/surge_governor.rs & controlplane/config/defaults.yaml: new governor knobs: governor.window_ms (defaults to 300ms), quarantine.batch_size (defaults to 16), max_quarantine_duration_ms.
- observability/metrics/registry.yaml: added metrics fallback_decision{outcome}, kv_drain_latency_ms, kv_drain_batch_size.
- tests/integration/fallback_quarantine_test.rs: synthetic region-failure harness that asserts no repeated reopens and that 99p latency regression is < 15% under the test load.
- docs/operational/kv-drain-and-fallback.md: runbook for on-call, rollout steps, and emergency rollback.

Testing and benchmarks: Unit tests added for bridge predicate logic and drain ordering. Integration canary executed via scripts/canary_run.sh across two regions simulated in CI (local cluster). Benchmarks on a small internal cluster (g4-equivalent) show the following: steady-state P50/P95 latency unchanged (+/-1%), P99 reduced from 640ms to 420ms for the synthetic failover scenario; the number of cross-region re-routes per minute dropped ~42% in stress tests. Memory and CPU overhead measured as <2% on the pilot footprint.

Operational notes / rollout plan: This was deployed as a hotfix to Dedicated pilot tenants first. Rollout strategy:
1) feature-flagged rollout to 10% of traffic in pilot region for 24h
2) monitor metrics: fallback_decision{outcome=held,executed}, kv_drain_latency_ms, tenant_slo_error_rate
3) if no regressions and P99 improves, ramp to 100% of pilot region then gradually to all regions over 3 days

Emergency rollback: flip feature flag off and trigger immediate drain cancellation path (controlplane/cancel_drain) which will re-enable previous fallback behavior. docs/operational/kv-drain-and-fallback.md contains the exact commands and playbook for on-call.

Review summary & discussion: Reviewer Marcus Nguyen requested tightening the default governor.window_ms from 500ms to 300ms (accepted) because experiments showed lower holdoffs reduced visible failover blur without reintroducing oscillation. Elena asked for explicit metrics to detect opaque bridge being a bottleneck; added fallback_decision timing and unit tests around it. Tomoko ran canary and reported an intermittent race in the drain_scheduler; fixed by adding a per-batch mutex and added more integration assertions.

CI: all unit and integration tests passed in CI. Lint and fmt checks passed. Canary runs completed successfully post-merge in staging.

Related work: addresses Linear tickets ENG-4521 (regional failover oscillation) and ENG-4598 (KV cache handoff tail latency). Also referenced SUP-1287 where customer incident traces motivated prioritizing KV drain ordering.

Merge: merged via squash on 2026-02-25 after approvals from reviewers and green CI. Release notes: "Hotfix: improve regional failover stability by introducing opaque fallback bridge and early KV-drain biasing; reduces P99 latency spikes during failover scenarios." No API breaking changes. Breaking_change: false.
